title.narrative: The Civic Accord: Enabling Voice, Justice, and Opportunity

description.narrative: The Civic Accord: Enabling Voice, Justice, and Opportunity addresses systemic repression, criminalisation of poverty, and civic exclusion through; legal response, economic empowerment, civic education, youth leadership, and institutional collaboration. Each year, with the help of our pro bono lawyers, 100 victims of human rights violations within Northern Nigeria will receive legal support. High-level collaboration with relevant government agencies will institutionalize early response protocols. Selected Correctional facilities will be transformed into spaces of opportunity through the remodeling and equipping of vocational hubs to deliver in-prison skills training, mind reformation, and educational support, equipping select offenders with tools for reintegration and civic re-inclusion. The Civic Influencers Incubation Fellowship will empower 24 high-impact young grassroots leaders, drawn from cultural spaces, student influencers, and youth movements with intensive training and micro-grants to execute bold civic projects. These initiatives will go beyond rhetoric, working to make rights, voice, and opportunity not aspirational ideals, but tangible, lived realities for Nigerians while ensuring visibility through digital media and other forms of media. National and intersectional in scope, the project will intentionally bridge gaps between established civic actors, grassroots voices, emerging advocates, cultural influencers, and public institutions with deepened partnerships with the National Human Rights Commission, Nigerian Bar Association, Nigerian Correctional Service and the Diplomatic Community.
